title: docs: make all seven guides easier to find
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The docs introduction, README, and plain-text agent index now list all seven guides with short descriptions: Connect User Wallets (BYOP), Publish an Agent, Publish a Model, Sandboxes, Coding Harnesses, MCP Servers, and CLI. The interactive docs sidebar groups them under Guides, while generated API Markdown reuses the introduction’s guide table; a maintenance test checks that the entry points stay in sync. The README adds a Guides link, moves its star-history graph below the Introduction, and removes the opening model-ID announcement. Documentation entry points now call the account credential a secret key, and the model overview’s Community Models heading becomes Community model discovery to avoid a duplicate anchor.
